speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you describe the nature of the tremors in your hands and when you first noticed the memory issues?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: The tremor started in one hand and has worsened over a year, accompanied by cognitive decline. Does the tremor occur when your hands are at rest, or does it mainly happen when you are trying to use them, like when holding a cup?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text:
You are exhibiting classic signs of Parkinson's disease, including a resting tremor, hypomimia, and soft speech, alongside cognitive decline. To confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes, I need to assess your muscle tone and check for any rigidity or bradykinesia during a physical exam.
